headline: Quest Capital Markets triggers substantial acquisition disclosure in PCBL Chemical Limited
sum: Quest Capital Markets Limited has crossed a material threshold in PCBL Chemical Limited and filed a mandatory Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Code. The filing signals either a 5%+ voting threshold breach or approach to an open offer trigger.
detail: Quest Capital Markets Limited has submitted to NSE a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This regulation mandates that when a person acquires 5% or more of voting shares in a listed company, or when holdings cross 10%, 15%, 25%, or 50%, the acquirer must publicly disclose within 2 working days. The disclosure typically includes the acquirer's identity, shareholding pattern, acquirer background, group entities, funding source, and intent (whether open offer or otherwise is contemplated). PCBL Chemical Limited is a chemical manufacturer listed on the BSE and NSE.
